title: NVIDIA board reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and director (22-Nov-2026), 11 days after accepting his resignation
body: 8-K filed 23-Nov-2026 (Item 5.02): on 22-Nov the board reinstated Huang as President, CEO and board member effective immediately; Kress stays EVP & CFO; Harvey C. Jones remains chair. Ex-99.1: unanimous vote after the board was 'satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang's candor'; board 'received input from senior levels of the United States government' that reinstatement 'poses no national security risk'. Independent-director committee investigation (into reporting that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort) 'will proceed to conclusion'; new National Security and Export Control Committee; Chief Compliance Officer search; company 'will continue to cooperate with ongoing government investigations and inquiries'. Sequel to event:US-NVDA:ceo-resignation-2026-11. Reported SEC disclosure probe (WSJ ~17-Nov) and California AG subpoena (~19-Nov) are press-reported only (verdict partly). Q3 FY27 10-Q not on EDGAR as of 26-Nov-2026.

data.sec_probe: reported (WSJ via PYMNTS/InvestmentNews), disclosure focus; unconfirmed by SEC/NVDA

title: NextEra–Dominion: HSR antitrust waiting period expired 18-Nov-2026
body: Dominion 8-K dated 20-Nov-2026 (Item 8.01): HSR waiting period expired 18-Nov-2026; closing remains subject to other regulatory approvals. Headline 'DOJ closes investigation' overstates (no DOJ statement found). Virginia SCC (PUR-2026-00112): companies' rebuttal (~3/4-Nov) accepted 101 of 117 staff/consumer-counsel conditions, 13 more with modifications, rejected the governor's 6-year rate freeze; SCC staff recommended rejection as proposed but would not oppose with its conditions (E+E Leader; WTVR 4-Nov; Virginia Business; GCN). Hearing outcome not yet reported.

title: UnitedHealth sues CMS over 2027 Medicare Advantage star ratings (~20-Nov-2026); CMS proposes CRUSH anti-fraud rule (~16-Nov-2026)
body: UNH suit vs CMS/HHS over 2027 MA star ratings: claims 26 measures improperly used across 45 contracts, correct calc would lift ratings ~0.5-1.5 stars; at least the 15th plan to sue; no ruling (Modern Healthcare; Healthcare Finance News; Medical Daily). CMS proposed rule CRUSH (CMS-6098-P): provider enrollment screening, expanded MA-plan fraud reporting, ~$90B 10-yr savings claimed; comments due 19-Jan-2027 (Becker's; Reuters via Capital.com). Size of insurer share move conflicts across sources (2-5% vs UNH -10.2%) - unverified.

title: Sugar administered prices, Nov-2026: Haryana SAP Rs 430 (2026-27), fortnightly release quota 13 LMT, UP SAP still pending, SC ethanol hearing 2-Dec
body: Confirmed: Haryana SAP 2026-27 Rs 430/qtl, 2027-28 Rs 450 (CM Saini 29-Oct-2026; NewsOnAIR, UNI); fortnightly domestic release quota (since Sep-2026), 13 LMT for 2nd fortnight Nov-2026 (DFPD ~13-Nov; Hans India, National Herald); UP SAP 2026-27 not announced as of 26-Nov-2026. Single-source: Punjab SAP Rs 431 (Tribune 25-Nov); SC interim bar on additional OMC ethanol allocation for Q2 ESY 2025-26, next hearing 2-Dec-2026 (ChiniMandi 20-Nov). Unconfirmed: 'sugar prices fall 20%'. Uttam has no Haryana/Punjab plants (benchmarks only). Full calendar: research_notes/Deep dives/UTTAMSUGAR_price_calendar.md.

title: RBI Governor meets NBFC, HFC and MFI heads (23-Nov-2026): responsible credit growth, fair recovery, cybersecurity; no new directive
body: RBI press release (prid 64032): Governor met MDs/CEOs of select NBFCs (incl. govt NBFCs), HFCs and MFIs, with Sa-Dhan, MFIN, FIDC; DGs present. Emphasised responsible and sustainable credit growth, customer-first, grievance redressal, fair recovery practices, CKYCR use, cybersecurity. Release does not mention 'microfinance stress', gold loans or 'reckless growth' (headline framing). SFBs not in this meeting. Sector context for Utkarsh SFB (L41); neutral.

title: Polycab India: NCLAT sets aside NCLT order admitting CIRP over Rs 2.78 cr Asier Metals claim (30-Oct-2026)
body: Polycab NSE filing 30-Oct-2026: NCLAT order setting aside the NCLT Ahmedabad CIRP admission (CA(AT)(Ins) 1940/2026; plausible pre-existing dispute). LiveLaw, Bar & Bench concur. A 25-Nov-2026 headline ('NCLAT reserves order') was stale. Immaterial to margins; may be appealed to SC.

title: Marico: audit committee levies Rs 3 lakh on independent director Bhaskar Bhat for spouse's closed-window purchase (disclosed 20-Nov-2026)
body: Marico letter to NSE/BSE 20-Nov-2026: spouse Ms. Vrunda Bhaskar bought 200 shares on 8-Nov-2026 (Rs 1.79 lakh) in the prohibited period (UPSI public 6-Nov; window to 11-Nov); audit committee found it inadvertent; Rs 3 lakh penalty remitted to SEBI IPEF. Minor, properly disclosed.

title: TVS promoter family: Lakshmi Venu serves partition notice on Venu Srinivasan (dated 16-Nov-2026); no confirmed Madras HC suit
body: Partition notice under the Hindu Succession Act to Chairman Emeritus Venu Srinivasan, backed by Mallika Srinivasan; caveats filed by both sides (Business Today 16-Nov; YourStory; Deccan Chronicle). Headline 'moves Madras High Court' not confirmed. TVS Motor itself not a reported party; no company filing on it. Promoter-family governance watch (stage 2).
